text:
maya: Heads up: e2e perf gate failed on runs/e2e-perf/nightly for main at abc1234 — p95 latency jumped ~30%, threshold 200ms -> 260ms. Test job: e2e-perf-20260317-41. Link: https://dash.redwood/ops/e2e-perf?run=41
ci-bot: e2e-perf-check failed: p95 260ms > 200ms (threshold breach). See logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/e2e-perf-41
tim: on it. is this reproducible locally? which workload?
maya: it's the small-seq (64) chat throughput test and the async-batch path. repro on my laptop is noisy; I'll try a headless run. suspect recent batching scheduler change by @sasha (PR #7124) but not certain.
sasha: i only touched scheduler backpressure math, shouldn't affect latency tail but can affect batching behavior. i'll bisect if you want.
liam: can someone run a bisect job in CI? we should run binary bisect across commits from last green: range abc090..abc1234. Otherwise we can revert sasha's PR to be safe.
devon: i can kick off a bisect, but need the CI job template name. Also recommend running 'e2e-perf --smoke --repeat 10 --seed 42' locally.
maya: ```
CI trigger:
curl -X POST https://ci.redwood/api/trigger \
  -d '{"job":"e2e-perf-bisect","range":"abc090:abc1234"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN'
```
ci-bot: Bisect job queued: e2e-perf-bisect-78. Triggered by @devon. ETA ~30m per bisect step.
sasha: :grimacing: okay i'll hold off any more batching changes. thanks devon.
devon: update: first few bisect steps show regressions start after abc115 (the change to kernel selection fallbacks). running targeted bisect now.
tim: if kernel selection change is suspect, could be config toggles in runtime flags. @eng-runtime can we try toggling KERNEL_FALLBACK=off on a test run?
maya: good idea — i'm spinning a private run with KERNEL_FALLBACK=off now.
ci-bot: e2e-perf-private-93 completed: p95 198ms — looks within threshold when fallback off.
liam: that's pretty telling. sasha could the PR have enabled fallback earlier?
sasha: i didn't change default, but abc115 bumped runtime version that picks a new fallback path. i'll open a patch to add a feature-flag and revert for prod. assigning @sasha.
devon: created issue: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/5432 — added bisect results and logs. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-sre for rollback discussion.
tim: next steps: merge hotfix to pin kernel selection and revert runtime bump from abc115 in prod. owner: sasha. I'll coordinate on deployment window. :thumbsup:
maya: :white_check_mark: filing rollback PR now.
ci-bot: note: original e2e-perf job will be rerun after merge. keep channel updated.
